cohort: 50 preterm neonates born ≤30 weeks of gestation
finding: Innate immune antimicrobial defenses, measured by cytokine responses to TLR agonists, remain developmentally attenuated in very preterm neonates during the neonatal period, suggesting exogenous factors may contribute to systemic inflammation and morbidities in these infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to significantly contribute to the maturation of cytokine responses.
